mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS positionId,p.import_file_id AS importFileId,p.position_code AS positionCode,p.position_name AS positionName, p.department_name AS departmentName,p.organization_name AS organizationName,p.province,p.city,p.district,p.recruit_count AS recruitCount, p.education_requirement AS educationRequirement,COALESCE(f.effective_major_requirement,p.major_requirement) AS majorRequirement, f.work_location_name AS workLocationName,f.work_location_status AS workLocationStatus FROM job_match m JOIN job_position p ON p.id=m.job_position_id LEFT JOIN job_position_feature f ON f.position_id=p.id WHERE m.profile_id=#{profileId} AND m.match_result='MATCH' AND m.import_file_id=#{importId} ORDER BY p.id
